author: jareth forrester

title: A revelation!
body: Sunsama is the app I’ve been looking for! It is not jealous, requiring you to make it the only app in your life, rather it is the great collaborator bringing all apps to work together so you can make sense of your day, feel good about it through reflection and not overestimating how much you can get done (classic ADHD trait), and draws in tasks from all your projects and tools. Well done you people. Thankyou for all you do.
author: razzy77

title: Rubbish on iOS
body: The desktop app is great, web version is ok, but the iPhone version is abysmal, with the iPad version being lower than rock bottom. A poor interface, followed by some horrific glitches nearly ruined my day on my first use. They would be better off removing this from the store entirely and spending time on making it work, because all this app does is ruin Sunsama’s reputation.
author: SpanPanic

title: Too buggy to be useful
body:
A pop up appears every few hours that can’t be dismissed without reinstalling the app.

It takes two or three tries to log in with google.
